concerns.text: Task T027 implements Granger causality tests sweeping lags {2, 3, 7, 14}. Spec FR-005 and User Story 3 explicitly mandate a fixed-sweep of lags {1, 2, 3, 7, 14}. The omission of lag=1 in the task description means the implementation cannot satisfy the requirement to test the 1-day anticipatory dynamic.

Task T027 describes generating Granger results but does not explicitly mandate applying the Bonferroni-corrected threshold (p < 0.01) during the generation/sensitivity calculation phase. While T029 validates the final result, the generation task itself lacks the constraint definition required by FR-005 and SC-002, risking a mismatch between generated data and success criteria.

Task T028 calculates sensitivity based on 'lags in {1, 2, 3, 7, 14}', but relies on T027 which only generates results for {2, 3, 7, 14}. This creates a logical gap where the sensitivity analysis task expects data (lag=1) that the preceding generation task does not produce.
